rule_audit.name: VAWA eviction protection
rule_audit.label: VAWA eviction protection (34 U.S.C. § 12491; 24 C.F.R. § 5.2005)
rule_audit.summary: In a covered housing program, including Section 8 tenant-based assistance such as the Housing Choice Voucher program, victim status or an incident directly resulting from domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, or stalking cannot itself be a basis for covered adverse action, subject to statutory exceptions.

rule_audit.name: VAWA eviction protection
rule_audit.label: VAWA eviction protection (34 U.S.C. § 12491; 24 C.F.R. § 5.2005)
rule_audit.summary: In a covered housing program, including Section 8 tenant-based assistance such as the Housing Choice Voucher program, victim status or an incident directly resulting from domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, or stalking cannot itself be a basis for covered adverse action, subject to statutory exceptions.
